title: White Bear, Deku and the old trumpeter living on Burgundy Street
summary: Talk of local musicians' hangouts and an elderly man still living on Burgundy Street whom Rene knew when he was young.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I saw a little dick named White Bear. He hangs in a burglar's spread out of the hood. Him and this fellow Deku. That's where they hang out. Every night if I want to find him to look him up.
Well they, let's see, Deku was living with the two of them. I was there with Tom Alba, you know. Tom Alba still got that place. Oh, down Burgundy Street?
Oh sure. I see him once a week or so, maybe twice. Oh yeah. I'm always passing by. Oh yeah, I see.
I believe he's 82 now, about that age.
He's a pretty old man, because he was, when I was a young man, he was pretty good up in the age. He must have been around a man about 35, 40 years at that time. I mean I'm 63 now. I'll be 63.
